report_title: # P0037 ARC12 Cross-Separator Reflection Development-40 Packet
claim_boundary: This source-pinned, failure-inclusive P0037 packet compares one bounded cross-separator quadrant-reflection compatibility family against P0036's immutable 2/40 same-cohort baseline. The P0036 filename-only 20 ARC-AGI-1 plus 20 ARC-AGI-2 all-training roster was committed at 6d09ea307ec1accc7f85f1ff486bfb77906e4a78 before its selected task grids were parsed. Its retained post-answer development evidence exposed a structural failure family, so P0037 is intentionally a same-cohort development comparison rather than fresh transfer. The new family dynamically rederives a centered uniform structural cross, exactly one nonuniform payload quadrant, three agreeing uniform background quadrants, and one payload color; it reflects the payload mask to all four quadrants and recolors it to the structural-cross color, refusing any ambiguous alternative. It does not branch on task ID, fixed colors, GT labels, cohort metadata, historical decomposition, or held-out test output. The controller receives only each task's visible demonstrations and test input before committing a complete grid. The generic family and visual-label renderer are frozen at 5593527a16a57bcc0925ae3692b0888f141452e3 before this packet runs; P0037 results cannot further retune them. Any positive result is same-cohort development evidence only, not ARC-AGI-1 or ARC-AGI-2 transfer or solver evidence.

baseline_reference.comparison_boundary: P0036 is the immutable pre-change same-cohort denominator. P0037 may report only a within-cohort development difference; it cannot revise P0036 or serve as fresh transfer evidence.

prior_transfer_reference.comparison_boundary: P0035 is immutable fresh all-training-subset transfer evidence for the prior vocabulary. P0037 does not alter it and cannot be compared as a transfer delta.

offline_diagnostic_provenance.role: P0036's exposed task-level development evidence informed the one generic P0037 family, but the live controller implementation imports, parses, calls, and receives none of the GT feature records or GT solver code. The P0037 evaluation is deliberately same-cohort development, and that provenance is not hidden.

synthetic_contract.coverage: The synthetic contract varies background, separator, payload color, panel width, and active quadrant; it rejects competing payload quadrants and background-colored separators.

visual_contract.coverage: The renderer keeps ARC black and magenta distinct and uses readable labels for central-separator and cross-reflection operators.
